notes.title: Versus Mode Bug Fixes and Other Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]Versus Mode Fixes[/h3]
Fixed incorrect attribute classification for Original Characters.
Fixed an issue where Original Character card backgrounds could turn white during 3on3 battles.
Fixed an issue where transferred Original Characters’ voice lines would not play at battle start in 3on3.
Fixed an issue where the game did not reload after importing transfer data.

[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]
Skill “Poison Magic”: fixed incorrect MAG increase calculation.
Fixed an issue where Very Hard did not unlock after clearing Hard mode with an Original Character.

[h3]Known Issues (to be addressed later)[/h3]
In 3v3, the cut-in image does not switch when changing characters.
In mirror matches (same character vs. same character), the name text color remains blue.

notes.title: We’ve fixed several issues introduced by the September 6 update.
notes.notes:
Fixed the bugs that occurred after adding the versus (PvP) feature.

[h3]Issues Fixed[/h3]
• Fixed an issue where the game could become unresponsive when time ran out.
In Normal Mode, the issue can be resolved by selecting Give Up or by restarting the game once.
• Fixed several areas that were not properly localized into English.

[h3]Currently Known Issues (to be addressed)[/h3]
• In 3vs3, the cut-in image does not change when a character is switched.
• Voice audio does not play for imported original characters.
• In mirror matches (same character vs. same character), the name color remains fixed to blue.

Thank you for your continued support of VTBattle.

notes.title: Status Adjustments and New Features Update
notes.notes:
We've made several updates to improve the gameplay experience:

Status Adjustments for All VTubers
VTuber stats have been adjusted.
VTubers with less than 33 stat points (used for the original character system) have been corrected to have at least 33.
Additionally, VTubers with excessively high stats have been adjusted to a new maximum of 36.

One New Hidden Character Added
A new hidden character has been added to the game.

Result Data Can Now Be Deleted
You can now delete your result data.
Click the "Delete" button in the upper right corner of the result screen.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247672/363727f5ae86407fd0cd0dc962639600211dd56e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247672/b488e82afe4b11093797c8a10c610c3e55ed0028.png[/img][/url]

Card Packs Can Now Be Opened After Battle
Previously, card packs couldn't be opened from the result screen. Now you can open card packs after a battle from the result screen.
We plan to implement a new mode that uses result data, so please try it out!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247672/dba8f83b41135bbdc194d8a0abe50007bfbf366d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247672/8b3fe580220d12c84eacdbad8b13d3380fde73f7.png[/img][/url]

Fixed Name Color Issue in Battle Logs
Fixed an issue where some character names were not showing the correct text color when enlarging the battle log.

We will continue to improve the game with regular updates.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update: Edit/Delete Buttons for Original Characters & Auto-Save Format Fix
notes.notes:
Edit/Delete Buttons Added for Original Characters
You can now edit or delete your original characters (excluding status, attribute, and type).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247672/dd5e6218cea2a5c2a376b7aa5f43125cab6c8e03.jpg[/img]

Save Data Format Fixed
This is a behind-the-scenes change, but the method of saving data has been updated.
Previously, due to the way Assets were used, there was a chance save data could be lost.
With this update, save data should no longer be deleted.
If you encounter any issues such as unexpected data deletion, please let us know.

Thank you for your continued support of VTBattle!

notes.title: VTBattle - 4th Update Announcement
notes.notes:
On March 9, 2025 (Sunday), the 4th card pack "RealitySync" will be released for VTBattle: It's Not About Subscribers! Strength Decides the Winner!, available now on Steam!
With this update, the total number of participating VTubers will increase from 105 to 140! Additionally, players who meet specific conditions can unlock hidden characters!

[Highlights of the 4th Update]
-35 new VTubers join the battle!
-New type "Gambler" added!
-43 brand-new skills introduced!
-New status effects: "Diminish" & "Mana Down"!
-Card HP adjustments for better balance!
-Five new in-game events added!

[About the New Type: "Gambler"]
The Gambler is a new sub-type of the Balanced class that introduces a high-risk, high-reward playstyle.

Normal attacks are slightly weaker, but strong attacks and magic attacks are more powerful compared to other types.
Special moves rely on rolling a dice!
Roll a 1 → Execute a powerful special attack without consuming the gauge!
Roll a 6 → Your HP is cut in half!?
This type challenges players to decide whether to take risks or play it safe in battle!

[A Sneak Peek at New Skills]
Elemental Power Lv1 (U) – When set in slot 1, increases ATK and MAG by 1.1x for cards of the same element.
Pebble Throw (U) – 80% chance to deal a fixed 100 damage.
Dull Blade Lv1 (SR) – 15% chance to inflict Diminish (halves ATK for the next turn).
Mystic Word β (SSR) – 20% chance to inflict Mana Down (halves MAG for the next turn).
New Status Effects
Diminish – ATK is halved until the next turn.
Mana Down – MAG is halved until the next turn.
These new status effects add more depth to battles—use them wisely to gain an advantage!

[Other Updates & Fixes]
Updated the SSR illustration for Watasuke.
Updated the SSR illustration and autograph position for Rōre. (Players who already own the card can check the changes from the character card screen.)
Fixed display issues in the results screen.
Fixed a bug where opponent cards remained visible during battle.
Added a filtering feature to sort by element in card and protagonist selection.
Thank you for your continued support of VTBattle: It's Not About Subscribers! Strength Decides the Winner!

We hope you enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: Update：You can now set up to 5 decks!
notes.notes:
・You can now set up to 5 decks!
In the deck selection screen, you can now check not only the cards but also their stats, type, and element.

・Element Change is now more clearly reflected.
When setting an Element Change, only your own element will now be modified. This change is also reflected when checking your deck and comparing statuses, so be sure to check it out!
Note: Enemy elements will not change unless you check their cards, so please keep that in mind.

・Type Change is now more clearly reflected.
Just like Element Change, Type Change will now be properly applied.

・Removed the "Previously Played Character" data from Early Access.
Fixed a bug where the "Previously Played Character" would still be selectable when choosing a character in Early Access.

notes.title: Auto-Save Feature Update
notes.notes:
The auto-save feature has been adjusted to save progress at various points to prevent data loss in case of a crash. If the game crashes, you can now resume from where you left off.

Additionally, there have been minor changes to the UI to prepare for upcoming feature additions. You may notice some awkward spacing, but please understand this is part of the groundwork for future updates.

Thank you for your continued support of VTBattle!

notes.title: Ver1.0.0.8 Update – Optimization and Skill Activation Fixes
notes.notes:
・We have released the Ver1.0.0.8 update. Below are the details of the improvements:

Key Improvements
1)Game Optimization
Reduced the loading time when starting the game.
Revised the data processing method, changing from preloading all data at startup to a dynamic loading system that loads data as needed.
As a result, some images may not appear immediately after a screen transition. This adjustment was made to optimize overall game performance.
Further optimization improvements are planned for future updates.
Improved Initial Skill Activation in Battles

2)Skills at the start of a battle now activate one by one in sequence.
Actions such as "Attack," "Type Change," and "Element Change" are now processed step by step to ensure smoother and more stable gameplay.
3)Minor Text Fixes

Several minor text-related corrections have been made.
We experienced a few issues during earlier updates, but this time we believe the game is stable.
If you encounter any problems, please let us know. Thank you for your continued support of "V-Tuber Battle: It’s Not About Subscribers, It’s About Power!"

notes.title: Official Release on December 19, 2024!
notes.notes:
Official Release on December 19, 2024!
The second game produced by independent VTuber "Wataritama":
"VTuber Battle: It's Not About Subscribers! It's About Strength!"

■ Changes in the Official Release
Character Packs
You can now purchase character packs from the menu screen!
Previously, all characters were available by default. Now, you can unlock additional characters by purchasing character packs.

Training Your Favorite VTuber
After clearing stages, your VTuber can now gain experience points and level up!
Leveling up grants skill points, which you can allocate to further strengthen your favorite VTuber.

Difficulty Levels
You can now choose from three difficulty levels: EASY, NORMAL, and HARD.

EASY: Designed for beginners. Clear all 10 battles to finish. With a first-clear bonus, it's ideal for initial leveling.
NORMAL: The main mode of VTuber Battle. Aim for 30 victories and prove your skills!
HARD: For experienced players. Maximize your skills and take on this challenging mode.
New Character Types
In addition to the existing types—Balance, Attacker, and Magic—four new types have been added!

Knight: A derivative of Attacker. Boasts high defense and excels at converting that defense into powerful attacks.
Rogue: A derivative of Attacker. Specializes in swift movements and multi-hit combos that reduce the target's defense.
Sorcerer: A derivative of Magic. Adds paralysis effects to ultimate moves and skills.
Healer: A derivative of Magic. Besides magic attacks, can also heal and nullify status ailments.
New Skills
The number of skills has significantly increased!
The Early Access version had 139 skills, but now there are over 200.

Balance Adjustments
Adjusted SPD growth rates. Strengthening SPD now increases it more gradually. Correspondingly, characters with high SPD stats have been rebalanced.
Reduced the values of status-boosting cards across the board. Pure stat boosts were overly powerful, so values have been decreased, especially for DEF and MDEF.

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Element Change Appearance Rate Adjustment
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where pressing the "Back" button from the owned cards screen would lead to a gray screen.
Adjusted the appearance rate of Element Change. Element Change will now appear more frequently than before. Although the increase is slight, it’s balanced so that consecutive appearances can still happen. Occasionally, Element Change might appear too frequently, but this also makes it easier to switch to higher-level ones. Please make good use of this in your strategy!

After Revision:

This change makes it easier to take advantage of rerolling.

Profile View for the Main Character
You can now view the profile of the main character.

View Profile from Card Details
Profiles are now accessible from the card details.

Text Change for "Medium Magic Probability Increase Lv.〇" and "Strong Magic Probability Increase Lv.〇"
Updated text from "Medium Attribute Magic" to "Medium Magic," etc.
